name: Veron Amberstill
summary: At Amberstill Ranch in eastern Dun Morogh, Veron Amberstill tends the rams Ironforge riders trust.

sections.title: Master of the Mounts
sections.body: Veron Amberstill breeds and trains mountain rams at Amberstill Ranch in eastern Dun Morogh. Their sure footing and thick coats suit the steep slopes and mountain blizzards of Khaz Modan. He raises them to carry dwarven scouts, mountaineers, and traveling adventurers. Veron offers standard and swift mounts to fellow dwarves. Riders from other peoples must prove loyalty to Ironforge's throne before he parts with a ram.

faq.answer: Veron Amberstill breeds mounts at Amberstill Ranch in Dun Morogh. He raises sturdy mountain rams for Ironforge and sells them to qualified riders.

faq.q: Can non-dwarves purchase rams from Veron?
faq.answer: Yes. Dwarves can buy Veron's rams, while outsiders must earn an exalted reputation with Ironforge before he entrusts them with his herd.
You can find Veron outside Amberstill Ranch in the hills of eastern Dun Morogh, just north of Gol'Bolar Quarry.

faq.q: Why do dwarves ride rams instead of horses?
faq.answer: Mountain rams have thick coats, sturdy frames, and sure footing, which suit Dun Morogh's freezing winds and sheer rocky ledges better than ordinary horses.

angles.text: As a dwarf, you can see your people's ties to mountain rams in the standard and swift mounts Veron raises for riders across Khaz Modan.
As an ally of Ironforge, you must prove your dedication to the dwarven kingdom to earn Veron's respect and ride a mountain ram.
